rules.title: Ruby 3.2 is end-of-life
rules.summary: The Ruby maintenance branches page marks Ruby 3.2 as eol: normal maintenance ended on 2025-04-01 and the branch reached end-of-life on 2026-04-01.

constraints: Keep .ruby-version, .tool-versions, the Gemfile ruby directive, Gemfile.lock RUBY VERSION, gemspec required_ruby_version, CI matrices, and container images on one supported Ruby branch.
Confirm gems with native extensions build on the target Ruby and reinstall bundled gems.

steps.title: Raise the Ruby version
steps.instructions: Change the reported declaration from Ruby 3.2 to a supported release (see the replacement), using the project's existing version manager.

steps.title: Align other Ruby version surfaces
steps.instructions: Update CI setup-ruby versions, Dockerfile `ruby:` images, the Gemfile ruby directive, Gemfile.lock, and gemspec required_ruby_version so they agree.

verification.purpose: Confirm the active runtime is the intended release.
Re-resolve and install gems on the new Ruby.
Run the test suite on the new Ruby.

rules.title: Rails 7.2 is end-of-life
rules.summary: The Rails maintenance policy no longer lists Rails 7.2.x as supported. The Rails end-of-support announcement set its security support deadline to 2026-08-09.

constraints: Preserve application behavior and public interfaces while applying the official Rails 8.0 and 8.1 upgrade sections in order.
Upgrade Ruby separately and first when necessary; Rails 8.0 and 8.1 require Ruby 3.2 or newer.
Keep the Gemfile requirement and every Gemfile.lock on the same supported Rails release series.

steps.title: Upgrade Rails 7.2 to Rails 8.0, then 8.1
steps.instructions: Set Rails to the latest 8.0 patch and run `bundle update rails`; after the application passes its checks, repeat for Rails 8.1.x.

steps.title: Apply the Rails 8.0 and 8.1 upgrade sections
steps.instructions: Follow the official 7.2-to-8.0 and 8.0-to-8.1 sections, resolve each listed behavior change, and run the application tests between the two upgrades.

steps.title: Review the new framework defaults
steps.instructions: Run `bin/rails app:update`, review every generated change, enable the new framework defaults gradually, and update `config.load_defaults` only after the application is ready.

verification.purpose: Confirm the updated Rails dependency set is installed and consistent.
Run the Rails test suite after each upgrade step.
Confirm the application boots on the intended Rails release.

rules.title: Rails 8.0 security support is scheduled to end
rules.summary: The Rails maintenance policy says Rails 8.0.x receives security fixes until 2026-11-07. Rails 8.1.x is the newer supported release series.

constraints: Preserve application behavior and public interfaces while applying the official Rails 8.1 upgrade section.
Keep the Gemfile requirement and every Gemfile.lock on the same Rails 8.1 release series.

steps.title: Upgrade Rails to 8.1
steps.instructions: Set Rails to the latest 8.1 patch in the Gemfile and run `bundle update rails` to refresh every Gemfile.lock.

steps.title: Apply the Rails 8.1 upgrade section
steps.instructions: Follow the official 8.0-to-8.1 section and resolve each listed behavior change before enabling the Rails 8.1 framework defaults.

steps.title: Review the Rails 8.1 defaults
steps.instructions: Run `bin/rails app:update`, review every generated change, enable the new framework defaults gradually, and update `config.load_defaults` only after the application is ready.

verification.purpose: Confirm the updated Rails dependency set is installed and consistent.
Run the Rails test suite after the upgrade.
Confirm the application boots on Rails 8.1.

rules.title: json 2.17.1.1 is yanked
rules.summary: RubyGems lists json 2.17.1.1 as yanked: the version is not available for download or for other gems that depended on it. The version page also flags two known security vulnerabilities.
rules.replacement: A published json release that is not yanked

constraints: Keep the Gemfile requirement, Gemfile.lock resolved version, and gemspec constraint on a published json release.
Regenerate the lockfile after changing the requirement; do not keep a yanked version in the resolution.

steps.title: Move off the yanked version
steps.instructions: Change the Gemfile or gemspec constraint to a published json release and run `bundle update json` so Gemfile.lock resolves a version that is not yanked.

steps.title: Align the lockfile and gemspec
steps.instructions: Check every Gemfile.lock in the repository and the gemspec constraint so none resolves the yanked version.

verification.purpose: Confirm the resolved json version.
Run the test suite with the replacement version.
